title: Receive what is given under Hukam
summary: What pleases the Lord comes to pass, and what is given is what we receive. The daily practice is not control, but clean receiving under the True Creator.
takeaway: Receive what is given without pretending you authored the day.
lifeApplication: When the day gives what you did not choose, open the hand before the argument. Receive first; decide the next faithful step after the fist relaxes.

source.shortMeaning: What pleases the Lord comes to pass; what is given is what we receive.
source.lifeApplication: When resistance rises, unclench the hand and receive what has been placed there.

evidence.coreClaim: What pleases the Lord comes to pass; what is given is what we receive.
evidence.turn: The heart moves from carrying outcomes by force to receiving them under the Creator.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the day gives what you did not choose, open the hand before the argument. Receive first; decide the next faithful step after the fist relaxes.
